semantics.identity_rule: Concrete domain instance/context has an explicit identity.
semantics.module_instance_rule: Composed Universal Module instances are exact refs.
semantics.data_rule: Domain context does not merge underlying module-instance data scopes by implication.
semantics.lifecycle_rule: Configured/active context state is separate from Domain definition.
semantics.authority_rule: Context membership is not AccessCore authorization.

invariants.rule: Composition never silently transfers semantic ownership: universal modules own their primitives, domains own their composition semantics, and composed members retain their own identities and contracts.

Containment, relation, dependency, composition and projection edges exist only through explicit typed references; naming, file hierarchy, UI adjacency or shared values never create semantic structure.
